iWant: Squire to save where we are and ask me to type /clear at a natural pause when a conversation gets long
soThat: long conversations stay quick and nothing is lost
description: The context watch: Squire notices a long conversation (high context use or compaction), writes its handover note, asks for /clear at a natural pause, and picks up from the note.
title: Fresh start: a handover note, then /clear at a good moment

acceptanceCriteria.description: A long conversation gets a handover note and a timely /clear prompt, and nothing is lost.
acceptanceCriteria.given: A conversation past Squire's context threshold, with work in progress
acceptanceCriteria.when: Squire reaches a natural pause, and the Squire owner then types /clear
acceptanceCriteria.then: The handover note is saved before the /clear prompt is shown, and after /clear Squire picks up the work in progress from it.
